title: Hanasato Minori — For "Your" Sake〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few days before the show
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four!
And pose!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Yes...!
I did just the way I imagined...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're doing great today too, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You really are. It's so amazing that you've been able to master this dance in such a short period of time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's all thanks to getting so much done in SEKAI alongside our usual practices.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (As long as I can keep this up, we'll be okay... I think...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We know that you're doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we also can't let doubt creep into our viewers' minds.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Right. I need to make sure no one, including our fans, Haruka and the others, feel that way.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I need to keep smiling!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Did I do that okay...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have a few things to take care of, so we'll be heading off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Feel free to stay and practice, but not too late, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! See you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright! It's time to...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How about we take a water break before starting back up again?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm back. Here's yours, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Haruka!
I'm thirsty!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haruka...?
I'm not sure that I can relax or take a drink with you staring at me like that, maybe...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? Even though you're always watching me do everything?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! Oh, I... That's...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Haruka was watching me practice that whole time just now too...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She seemed genuinely worried about me when we went home together that one day too.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait! Does this mean I'm making her worry about me again?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, I have to tell her that everything is alright now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (B-But what if I'm wrong...?! That would also be really embarrassing...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe... Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You were making some funny expressions just now, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was wondering what was on your mind too. One moment you looked surprised, but turned red a second later. Just one expression after another.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-what?! I just let it show?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you did. So what were you thinking about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, umm... I was worried that you asked me to take a break because you were concerned about me again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I just suggested that because I thought it was a good idea to stay hydrated...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like you're all better now, Minori. Especially after you asked me to believe in you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You've really been amazing lately.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Until now, you seemed to always be questioning yourself or not quite know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that's changed. Now, you seem much more confident about yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's probably because I met a fan of mine...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A fan?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! This person claiming to be my fan came up to me and even promised to watch our show...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For now, they may be the only one out there trying to support me right now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But for their sake, I want our show to go well!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But can I make one correction to that? Aside from that person, you have three other fans, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! You mean...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. Airi, Shizuku and myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your determination and the way you never give up are what helped us get back on our feet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So you... We'll be just fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Everything that was bothering me, like not practicing too much or that uneasiness I felt... It's all gone now...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(All it took was just one smiling face...
And Haruka... Haruka's so...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, nothing!
Please, ignore that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe...! I'm so happy!
I have four fans already!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One made me want to work even harder.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Four means I need to...
More and more and more and more...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehehe. That more and more might just turn into a pretty big number.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make sure that happens by having our show become a big success!
